stages.headline: An expression containing letters instead of some numbers is an algebraic (letter) expression; the letters are variables.
stages.headlineEnglish: An expression containing letters instead of some numbers is an algebraic (letter) expression; the letters are variables.

stages.headline: To find its value, substitute the given numbers for the letters and do the operations.

stages.headline: Letters let us write rules and formulas, e.g. a rectangle's perimeter P = 2(a + b) and distance s = v · t.
